image_description: A top-down view of a Dungeness crab (Cancer magister) positioned on a textured, dark green surface resembling moss or algae-covered rock. The crab features a broad, oval carapace with a purplish-brown to reddish hue and lighter mottling. Two large chelipeds (claws) are visible at the front, along with several walking legs extending laterally. The lighting creates highlights on the glossy exoskeleton.
